scripts.deploy: dotenvx run -f deploy.env -- bunx @prisma/cli@latest app deploy --db --env deploy.env
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:client: rm -rf dist/client && sass src/client:dist/client/assets --no-source-map && esbuild src/client/home.ts src/client/auth.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outdir=dist/client/assets
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'node:module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && rm -rf dist/views && cp -R src/server/views dist/views
